answer.label: fine-tuned
answer.justification: Only logit-level values were measured. Top-1 agreement is 0.938 and sequence agreement is 0.562, which sit at the edge of the fine-tuned range (0.900-0.938 and 0.47-0.64) and above the system-prompted range (0.861-0.908). The Token-DiFR gap of 0.226 fits fine-tuned (0.10-0.31), and quantized (0.03-0.04) is well below it. TV of 0.076 is the lowest fine-tuned value and also above the quantized range (0.048-0.055). The raw-score shift ÷ TV of 11.5 is slightly above the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8) but far from quantized (2.2-2.3) and system-prompted (3.3-3.9), so it points to a weight change from fine-tuning. KL of 0.071 is ambiguous: it falls in the quantized range but is just below the fine-tuned minimum. The other metrics make quantized unlikely, and base is ruled out because every value is non-zero.
